title: 第3章 个人任务选择庙祝第4章 成为吾之庙祝代吾行走人间
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
雷霆震耳。
仿若是上苍在宣告着什么。
李家村的村民们都被吓了一跳，连忙抬头望天，发现并没有要下雨的意思，只是一道旱雷。
“难道真是彰越公享用了？”
李有鸣佝偻着背，喃喃道。
他是村子里最德高望重的老人。
而且也是村子里两名‘炼体境’的武者之一。
虽然年纪大了，不怎么能打了。
但真要发起怒来，打死两三名成年男子还是问题不大。
毕竟——
他年轻时候修炼‘裂石掌’有成，气血蜕变过两次，掌力雄浑。
早几年，他一掌下去都还能打碎人头大小的石块。
村中最重要的财物一直是由他保管，特别是这株‘壮身草’已经保管了七年没有出过问题。
每一年的两次大祭。
这株‘壮身草’都要上一次彰越公的供桌，怎么这一次就不见了？
“肯定是彰越公享用了。”
旁边一名颤颤巍巍的老人开口道，看向土地公神像的目光格外虔诚。
“我看也是。”
“我们村的土地公可是灵验的很，前几年皮猴的媳妇一直怀不上，皮猴来彰越公这里求子，不到一年，皮猴媳妇就生下了一个大胖小子。”
另一名老人开口道。

等村民们再次将四周翻找了一遍还是没有任何收获后。
村长李德阳无奈道：
“有鸣叔，应该就是彰越公享用了。”
他虽然是村长，也是村子里除却李有鸣外的另一名‘炼体境’武者。
但他并不怎么相信土地公。
毕竟——
要是真有神只存在，这个世道还会妖魔邪祟横行吗？
每一年的大祭，他只是觉得可以让村民们更安心，有利于他这位村长的管理，所以才显得积极。
他心里面甚至有些怀疑。
这‘壮身草’是不是有鸣叔刚刚藏起来了。
不过没有证据的事情，他作为村长可不会乱说，那不利于团结。
“彰越公显灵了啊。”
“彰越公享用了供品，可一定要保佑我们村的儿郎们妖魔不受邪祟所害啊。”
李有鸣再次跪了下来，向着土地神像虔诚叩拜。
不少老人也跟着再次叩拜。
村长李德阳看着有鸣叔虔诚的样子，一时间都觉得——
会不会真是彰越公显灵、享用了供品？
不——
不可能的。
content_en:
The thunder was deafening.
It was as if God was announcing something.
The villagers in Lijia Village were all startled. They quickly looked up at the sky and found that there was no sign of rain, just a drought thunder.
"Could it be that Duke Zhang Yue really enjoyed it?"
Li Youming hunched his back and murmured.
He is the most respected old man in the village.
And he is also one of the two warriors in the 'Physical Refining Realm' in the village.
Although I am older, I can't fight much.
But if he really gets angry, killing two or three adult men is not a big problem.
After all——
When he was young, he was successful in practicing 'Stone Splitting Palm'. His energy and blood transformed twice, and his palm power was powerful.
A few years ago, he could break rocks the size of a human head with one strike of his palm.
The most important property in the village has always been kept by him, especially this 'Strong Body Grass', which has been kept for seven years without any problems.
There are two big festivals every year.
This 'Strong Body Grass' was going to be offered to Lord Zhang Yue once, so why did it disappear this time?
"Mr. Zhangyue must have enjoyed it."
A trembling old man next to him said, looking at the statue of the God of Earth with a particularly pious look.
"I think so."
"The landlord of our village is very effective. In the past few years, Pihou's wife had been unable to conceive. Pihou came to Zhangyue Gong to ask for a child. Within a year, Pihou's wife gave birth to a fat boy."
Another old man spoke.
After the villagers searched around again but found nothing.
Village chief Li Deyang said helplessly:
"With Uncle Ming, it should be Duke Zhang Yue who enjoys it."
Although he is the village chief, he is also the other 'Physical Refining Realm' warrior in the village besides Li Youming.
But he doesn't really believe in the Earth God.
After all——
If gods really existed, would demons and evil spirits still be rampant in this world?
Every year during the big festival, he just felt that it would make the villagers feel more at ease and be conducive to his management as the village chief, so he was active.
He even had some doubts in his heart.
Did Uncle Ming hide this ‘Strong Body Grass’ just now?
However, as the village leader, he would not talk nonsense without evidence, as that would not be conducive to unity.
"Gong Zhangyue has appeared."
"Gong Zhangyue has enjoyed the offerings, but he must protect the sons and daughters of our village from evil spirits."
Li Youming knelt down again and bowed devoutly to the statue of the earth god.
Many old people also kowtowed again.
Village chief Li Deyang looked at Uncle Youming's pious look and felt for a moment——
Could it be that Lord Chang Yue really appeared and enjoyed the offerings?
No——
Impossible.
